name: Growing the LAN
description: One switch ran out of ports. Add a second and link them.
brief:
The office grew to four machines on two different floors. Build two switches, put two PCs on each, and run a single uplink cable between the switches.

Every machine stays in 10.0.0.0/24 — switches do not care about IP addresses, so one flat network spans both of them.

Name them PC-01 to PC-04, Switch-01 and Switch-02.
hints: Two switches, four PCs, five cables in total.
The cable between the two switches is just another cable.
PC-01 on Switch-01 must be able to ping PC-04 on Switch-02.
